╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│  PAGES                                                                       │
│  Esc 1 … Esc 7          Play, Sets, Recordings, Sounds, Settings, Help, Per… │
│  Esc f  /  Esc b        next / previous page                                 │
│  Esc                    from any page, back to Play                          │
│  The number is on each tab. Press Esc, then the key within 1.5 s, or hold A… │
│  F1-F7 still open those pages when the terminal sends function keys.         │
│  KEYS ON EACH PAGE                                                           │
│  Sets                   ↑↓ select · Enter load · a add to the set list · n … │
│  Recordings             ↑↓ select · Enter show the path · d delete (twice)   │
│  Sounds                 ↑↓ select · ←→ fold a group · Enter preview or fold… │
│  Settings               ↑↓ select · ←→ change · Enter edit or reload where … │
│  Help                   ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll                                  │
│  Perform                Enter go live · Esc n / Esc p next / previous · [ ]… │
│                                                                              │
│  PLAYING                                                                     │
│  ^E                     run the block under the cursor (the whole live_loop… │
│  Esc Enter              run the whole buffer, like Sonic Pi's Run            │
│  ^G                     stop every live_loop and thread, like Sonic Pi's St… │
